items.description: Segment is the web application that lets users collect, manage and route their customer analytics data. This mashup uses the Pipl API.
See dozens of current terror threats or incidents around the world. Includes airport, chemical, bridge, railway, bomb and other incidents. With links to related news stories and searchable database.

Oishii is kind of a del.icio.us mini-zeitgeist. oishii: ephemeral pheromonal del.icio.us-ness. It polls the del.icio.us front page every 5 minutes, and returns all sites bookmarked by at least 30 people.
Browse photos by Arab country name.
Insurance facts, terms, people, websites, history, and events in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting reference devoted to the Insurance industry.

Helps you find accommodations, events, activities, and things to do when planning a vacation or outing in Washington State. Locations and details of each activity are superimposed on a Virtual Earth map.
